title: Unauthorized Access to Video Stream
description: Video data transmitted from P2 to EE2 could be intercepted by unauthorized parties if encryption or secure channels are not properly implemented.
assumptions: Assumes standard security measures may have gaps in transit protection.

title: Direct Identification via Video Content
description: Approved video may inadvertently contain identifiable information (e.g., child's face, voice) enabling direct identification of EE2.
assumptions: Assumes approval process may not fully filter all PII.

title: Lack of Awareness of Data Processing
description: Child user (EE2) may not be informed about how their data is processed or that video streaming occurs.
assumptions: Assumes consent mechanisms may not adequately inform minors.

title: Non-Compliance with Child Privacy Regulations
description: Video streaming to minors may violate regulations like COPPA if parental consent or data minimization is not enforced.
assumptions: Assumes regulatory requirements for child data are not fully addressed.
